content: Figure FIGREF39 gives accuracy values of all baseline systems on the most frequent question types (appearing >25 times in the test data), as determined based on the question words (see Section SECREF19 ). The numbers depicted on the left-hand side of the y-axis represent model accuracy. The right-hand side of the y-axis indicates the number of times a question type appears in the test data.
